name: Website to Figma — HTML to Figma, URL to Figma — Import any site into editable layers (free)

networkAccess.reasoning: The plugin sends a URL to a renderer service, which opens that page in a real Chrome browser and returns its layers, styles and images. Users can point the plugin at a renderer they run themselves, so the address is not fixed. The imported page also references images on arbitrary third-party domains, which rules out an allowlist.
